name: Vienna Jaques
role: Boston convert who consecrated her savings to the Church
dateNote: Section 90, dated 8 March 1833, directs her to go to Zion; she reached Missouri by July 1833.
importance: Vienna Jaques was a laundress and nurse from Boston, baptized in July 1831, who moved to Kirtland and gave her money to the Church. Section 90 says she should receive money for her journey and an inheritance in Zion. She reached Independence in 1833 and nursed the sick in the 1834 camp. She later lived in Nauvoo and crossed the plains in 1847.
connections: Section 90 calls her “my handmaid” and says she should settle “in peace” on an inheritance from the bishop. She married Daniel Shearer about 1839.
